name: v2.01
description: Proposal-accurate Multi-Scale PatchTST: the committee-slide architecture (slides 9-14, 19) with every number chosen by Siwat on 2026-10-19. Nothing from Phase 4 tuning carried over.
decided: Siwat, 2026-10-19 (Q&A in the v3 rework session); written 2026-10-20

protocol.split: official 70/15/15 by date (validation only; test sealed)
protocol.labels: k x sigma_h fitted on training rows (k = 0.307 / 0.318 / 0.324 on the official split)

run.gpu: A100 or L4 (Siwat, 2026-10-20). Measured peak 15.9 GB at batch 256 on the A100 run of 2026-10-20; results are kept in a folder per GPU because GPU arithmetic differs.

_notes.stop_rule: mean = stop when the 3-horizon mean on the inner hold-out (the score that picks the kept weights) has not improved for patience epochs. Changed from every by Siwat 2026-10-20 04:08 after the first full run kept training past best epoch 17 + 5.
_notes.seeds: 4539913 / 9574315 / 2253758, chosen by Siwat 2026-10-20, replacing 20261015 / 16 / 17 used by E00-E31 and v2 (so runs are no longer paired seed-for-seed with those).
_notes.fixed: price_channels, sentiment, stock_identity: slide 9. indicators: proposal scope 2. pooling mean, scale_fusion attention: slides 11 and 19. trunk_width 128 and head_hidden 128/64: slides 12-13. price_target log_return: slide 9 and hard rule 1. horizons 1/5/10: proposal scope 4. protocol: earlier pre-registered decisions.
_notes.patches: 1 / 5 / 21 = day / week / month candles, stride = length (no overlap). The slide's 4 / 8 / 16 were placeholders (Siwat, 2026-10-19). Look-back 126 = 6 x 21: tokens 126 / 25 / 6; the week scale skips the oldest day.
_notes.sma_ema_200: Computed from each stock's full past history, not the 126-day window; about 2.4% of sample rows are filled with the training mean.
_notes.encoder_norm: batchnorm = PatchTST's own encoder layer (post-norm, GELU, attention dropout 0), src/encoders.py.
_notes.stock_id_dropout: probability that a training row's stock_id is replaced by 'unknown' (0); stocks with no training rows always use 'unknown'.
_notes.v2.02 keys: Added 2026-10-25 when v2.02 options were built; they state v2.01's behaviour explicitly (early stopping on, kept epoch = best mean macro-F1, constant lr, raw weights, no seed ensemble). The run of 2026-10-20 used exactly this behaviour.
